verdict.rationale: A tax agency can reasonably document sanctioned representative or authorized-provider channels, so the axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains only two probes recording HTTP 403 edge denials at www.ftb.ca.gov/robots.txt and webapp.ftb.ca.gov. Neither probe documents designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives, so this is none rather than na.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, the service documents a sanctioned third-party rail — designees, authorized providers, registered agents, or representatives — through which a provider can act for my company
